Name: Infinite Energy
Author: aurudev
Description:
This mod is made for people that only want the clock the be the limiting factor.

Works in Multiplayer. [b]Updated for 1.6![/b]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Sets your Energy Bar to max[/*]
[*]Hides Energy Bar[/*]
[*]Toggleable with [url=Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][/*]
[/list][b]Contributing[/b]
Feel free to report issues, e.g. bugs or mistakes in translation.

[b]Installation
[/b]1. This mod requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], so please, install that first.
2. Unzip the files into the Stardew Valley/Mods/Infinite Energy game folder.
3. Make sure the InfiniteEnergy.dll and manifest.json files are inside `Infinite Energy` folder, not in `Mods` folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI launcher.

Important, the Mods folder should look like this:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jrjzifa.png[/img]

If you have any issues, read the generic [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods]SMAPI mod installation[/url] instructions.
Alternatively install using Nexus's Vortex launcher.
